hud.bait_left.note: Bait is uncountable, so 0, 1 and 12 Bait all read correctly; no label rewrite needed.

hud.backpack.note: Roblox's own term; not 'rucksack', per the en-gb guide.

catch.success.note: Source 'a {rarity}' gives 'a Epic' / 'a Uncommon'; label form per the guide's 'New pet: {rarity} {pet}!' pattern. Source owner: apply the same rewrite to en-us.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Lucky Bait doubles your rare fish chance!

sell.done.note: Source gives '1 coins' when coins = 1; label form per the guide. 'fish' is the same for 1 and many. Source owner: apply the same rewrite to en-us.

ascend.confirm.text: Ascend now? You will start again but catch rare fish {bonus}% more often.
ascend.confirm.note: 'start over' is mainly US (Cambridge); 'start again' is the usual UK phrasing.

weather.storm.text: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting.

afk.kicked.text: You were idle for too long and stopped fishing.

daily.streak.text: Day {day} streak! Come back tomorrow for more.

tip.night.text: Tip: some fish only bite at night.

group.join.text: Join our community for 50 free bait!
group.join.note: Roblox's player UI says Communities since Nov 2024 (guide, glossary 'group'); 'our' as in the guide's social.group_reward row. Keep 'group' only if the game's other UI still says group. Source owner: same change in en-us.
